title: Map Builder drag, zoom, and framing
description:
Map Building sheets no longer snap back after you drag them. Persist was rebuilding highlights from a stale workspace snapshot before saving the live board, which undid page moves.

You can zoom further out (down to ~5%) so sheets look like puzzle pieces. The map canvas starts with a very large dead-space baseline and still grows in all directions as you move pieces. Opening Map Builder now frames the camera on the average center of all pages (and fits them in view) so you are not hunting in empty space.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync after deploy.
changeLog: Fix Map Builder sheet drag snap-back (capture live positions before highlight rebuild on persist).
Keep dragged moves when PDF iframes fire pointercancel mid-drag.
Lower map zoom floor to ~5% for puzzle-piece overview.
Huge map workspace baseline (~96 page spans) that still grows with layout.
Open Map Builder centered on the average of all page centers, fit-to-content.
